Ravi (KiteCare): Heads-up, running an APAC-focused pilot + Brazil fallback tomorrow 10:00 SGT. Need header allowlist and mTLS to sa-east-1 for failover. Please open CIDRs 198.51.100.200/29 and 203.0.113.192/26 on ap-northeast-1 and sa-east-1, set qps=1400 for a 9h window, auto-revoke at end, and capture token burn for renewal talk in 2 weeks.
Nora (CS): Copy. Can you confirm UTC start, expected steady vs peak, and whether they'll rotate keys during the window? I'll flag renewal risk if bursts are sustained.
Ravi (KiteCare): Start = 02:00 UTC. Steady ~650 qps, spikes to ~1400 for 12m every ~30m. No key rotation planned during the window. Please record perf and spend.
Ibrahim (Network Ops): I'll need CIDR ownership proof and the mTLS cert fingerprint. Proposed auto_revoke timestamp: 2024-11-12T11:00:00Z. Sana, can you prep the prod rollout and canary?
Sana (Solutions): Draft config below, confirm before push:
```
customer: kitecare
cidrs: ["198.51.100.200/29","203.0.113.192/26"]
regions: ["ap-northeast-1","sa-east-1"]
qps: 1400
duration: 9h
auto_revoke: 2024-11-12T11:00:00Z
allow_header: "x-kitecare-token"
mTLS_to_sa-east-1: true
fallback_threshold_pct: 80
```
Nora (CS): Looks good. Setting renewal status = "engaged" and scheduling a post-pilot 30m debrief. We'll ask for a consolidated spend+perf pack.
quota-bot: Quota request created: +13k tokens/hr for kitecare during window. Approve with `/approve quota 3225012345`
Nora (CS): Approved. :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim (Network Ops): Applying to staging now. Staging smoke: `curl -I https://proxy.tokyo.redwood/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. Plan prod cutover 20m before start and watch p50/p95 and 5xx.
Sana (Solutions): Canary started at 01:40 UTC; no immediate errors. Routing fallback to sa-east-1 will kick at 80% util and bring up mTLS route.
Ibrahim (Network Ops): Monitoring dashboards up, alert rules: p50>240ms or 5xx>0.5% -> page ops. Posting perf snapshot at 30m.
Nora (CS): I'll capture session notes and send enablement checklist + warmup steps to Ravi. Also adding reserved capacity options for renewal meeting.
Ravi (KiteCare): Thanks all, please highlight any token burn anomalies. We'll review the perf pack before the renewal meeting.
quota-bot: Quota change approved and active.
Ibrahim (Network Ops): Prod live at 01:40 UTC, watching first 2h. Good luck! :rocket:
